title: Accounting System Setup and Migration
summary: Select, configure and migrate to the right accounting and payroll software with a chart of accounts, tax settings and bank feeds.
metaTitle: Accounting System Setup: Zoho Books and Tally Migration
metaDescription: Choose, configure and migrate to the right accounting software: chart of accounts, tax settings, user roles, bank feeds and team training. 1 to 2 week fixed-fee project.
heroIntro: Get the right accounting system configured properly from day one: chart of accounts, tax settings, roles, bank feeds and training.
overview: The cheapest time to get your accounting set-up right is at the start. We select or review the software, configure the chart of accounts and tax settings, set user roles, connect bank feeds and train your team with a short user guide.
whatWeDo: Select, configure and migrate to the right accounting and payroll software.
Chart of accounts, tax settings and user roles.
Team training and a short user guide.
whoFor: New businesses choosing a system for the first time.
Teams migrating from one system to another.

faqs.q: Which software do you set up?
faqs.a: We commonly work with Zoho Books and Tally Prime, and can advise on others.
